name: Bezalel
overview: Bezalel, identified as the son of Uri of the tribe of Judah, was divinely appointed and gifted with wisdom and skill by the LORD to serve as the master craftsman in constructing the tabernacle and its sacred furnishings. Scripture highlights his unique calling and ability to execute God's detailed commands, including making the ark and the altar of burnt offering, demonstrating his vital role in the worship life of Israel. His work was not only skilled craftsmanship but also an act of obedience to God's specific instructions, underscoring the importance of God-ordained service in the community of faith.
